rationale.hitl-workflow: Human operators approve discrete lifecycle gates and arbitrate every consequential trade-off.
rationale.ai-review: Specialized AI adversaries critique designs and implementations against explicit lenses.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Compile, lint, automated tests, and scope inventories condition phase progression.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Spec-divergence checks, scope inventories, and approval rules bound implementation drift.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Teach-back and coverage matrices expose understanding gaps and critique concentration.
rationale.automation-bias: Experienced developers misjudge AI performance; structured checks target fluency-driven overtrust.
rationale.oversight-theater: Diagnoses affirmative self-validation as an ineffective, confidence-driven review ritual.
rationale.quality-debt: Architecture-first decomposition, simplification, and convergence gates directly target technical debt.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent specs trace decisions, assumptions, references, and rationale across versions.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes tool-capability explanations; argues process determines trustworthy AI development.
rationale.framework: Reusable eight-phase architecture defines artifacts, agents, and pipeline gates.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented the methodology as two Visual Studio Code extensions.
rationale.adopted: Multiple practitioners used it across twenty-plus production R&D projects.
rationale.agentic: AI produces phase artifacts and modules reviewed at discrete gates.
rationale.steering: Problem discovery, specs, and granularization substantively shape generation context.
rationale.metrics: Defines quality scores and convergence thresholds governing architectural progression.
rationale.risk-security: Security lenses and verification gates mitigate AI-generated application vulnerabilities.
rationale.risk-quality: Decomposition, simplification, testing, and debt analysis substantively target software quality.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Teach-back and adversarial checks mitigate fluency, sycophancy, and misplaced confidence.
rationale.method-field-study: Natural production use across projects supplies single-institution field evidence.
